description: Defines thread-safe lazy initialization utility functions using atomics and spin-locks within the starboard namespace.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Checks and sets the initialization state atomically, spinning if initialization is in progress.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the given state is initialized.

methods.name: SetInitialized
methods.description: Sets the state to initialized atomically.
